categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in smart logistics and intelligent manufacturing system integrated solutions, providing automated production lines and logistics systems planning, system integration, software development, equipment customization, electrical control system development, installation, commissioning, training, and after-sales services. It serves over 40 industries including new energy, petrochemical, tobacco, machinery manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, power, biomedicine, food and beverage, fresh cold chain, large supermarkets, communication electronics, and home daily chemicals. The business segments include system integrated solutions, intelligent hardware products (robots, stackers, AGVs), industrial software products, and after-sales maintenance services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages industrial internet-based digital technologies, including industrial IoT platforms, digital twin platforms, AI models, and data integration platforms to enable automation and digitalization. It develops intelligent logistics and manufacturing systems integrating automated warehouse systems, automated handling and conveying systems, automated sorting and picking systems, and information management systems. The company also develops intelligent control systems based on AI and edge computing, industrial robots, and software platforms such as warehouse management systems (WMS), logistics collaboration management systems (LCMS), manufacturing execution systems (MES), and equipment management systems (EMS). Production involves customized procurement and in-house assembly of electrical control equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers are large and medium-sized enterprises across diverse industries such as new energy, petrochemical, tobacco, machinery manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, power, biomedicine, food and beverage, fresh cold chain, large supermarkets, communication electronics, and home daily chemicals. The company serves manufacturing and logistics enterprises requiring automation and digital transformation of production and logistics processes. It also targets emerging potential industries and has expanded into overseas markets including Europe and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant revenue contributions from East China, Central China, South China, North China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast regions. It has established subsidiaries in Hungary and Singapore to support overseas market expansion. Overseas orders accounted for over 20% of total orders in 2024, with rapid growth in Europe and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing integrated smart logistics and intelligent manufacturing system solutions. It designs, develops, and integrates software and hardware systems, procures customized equipment from suppliers, assembles electrical control systems in-house, and delivers turnkey projects including installation and after-sales services. It acts as a system integrator and solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or end-user.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on innovation in smart logistics and intelligent manufacturing, emphasizing digital transformation and industrial internet platforms. Key R&D initiatives include developing industrial IoT platforms, digital twin technology, AI-driven intelligent control systems, integrated logistics platforms, and automation testing tools. The company pursues productization of solutions, expansion of intelligent hardware and software product lines, and localization of core components to enhance supply chain resilience. It also prioritizes internationalization and digital ecosystem development to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through customized system integration projects for smart logistics and intelligent manufacturing solutions, involving large-scale contracts typically obtained via bidding. The company also sells intelligent hardware products and industrial software, often bundled within projects or independently. Additionally, it earns revenue from after-sales maintenance and upgrade services under service contracts. Payment terms are milestone-based with staged payments linked to project progress and acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading integrated solution provider in China's smart logistics and intelligent manufacturing industry, with over 20 years of experience and a broad multi-industry customer base. The industry is increasingly competitive with market concentration among leading players and intensified competition from traditional equipment manufacturers transitioning to intelligent solutions. The company leverages its comprehensive capabilities, innovation, and service quality to maintain a strong market position and is expanding internationally to capture new growth opportunities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.37 billion, a 22.5% decline year-over-year, mainly due to macroeconomic slowdown and reduced downstream investment. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 276 million, down 28.8%. Despite revenue decline, new orders grew 7.25% to RMB 2.54 billion, with overseas orders increasing significantly by 172%. The company has total assets of about RMB 4.53 billion and equity of RMB 1.69 billion, with a stable gross margin around 26.7%. It maintains healthy cash flow and a solid financial position with an asset-liability ratio of 62.7%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through comprehensive end-to-end smart logistics and intelligent manufacturing solutions that integrate hardware, software, and services tailored to diverse industry needs. It emphasizes high-quality project delivery, advanced digital and AI technologies, and strong after-sales support to enhance customer operational efficiency and reduce costs. Its proprietary industrial internet platforms and digital twin technologies enable real-time monitoring and intelligent decision-making, providing customers with automation, flexibility, and data-driven management capabilities. The company’s multi-industry expertise and global expansion further strengthen its competitive edge.
